title: Reel 03 · Claude ke 4 Levels (with Flow hook)
hooks: (recorded) Claude ke 4 levels hain, aur zyada tar business owners Level 1 pe hi atke hain.
Aap Claude sirf chat ke liye use karte ho? Toh aap Level 1 pe ho.
Claude roz subah 9 baje aapke liye kaam kar sakta hai, bina aapke bole. Par uske liye Level 4 chahiye.

directions.name: Staircase world (recommended).
directions.pitch: One persistent glass staircase in the top half; the camera climbs one step per level, and each level's object (chat bubble, folder, plugs, clock) stays on its step. The 'YOU?' marker planted in beat 3 lands on step 4 in beat 15, which closes the loop.

directions.name: Phone that upgrades.
directions.pitch: One stylised phone; its screen changes per level (chat, project, connected apps, 9 AM notification). Simple and relatable, but it risks looking like a fake Claude app screen, so it needs care.

directions.name: Meera's morning.
directions.pitch: A boutique owner's morning gets easier at each level. Most emotional, but needs more scenes and text, so it's harder to read in 55 s.

beats.caption: 4 LEVELS hain
beats.visual: Google Flow shot of you (your Flow avatar, grey hoodie): night, stressed, forehead rub, then frantic copy-paste typing, phone buzzing. Big 'LEVEL 1' from frame 1.
beats.sfx: phone buzzes, fast typing, low hum; a soft hit on frame 1
beats.why: Relatable pain on the first frame; works muted. Two quick cuts, nothing held more than 1.5 s.

beats.words: zyada tar business owners Level 1 pe hi atke hain.
beats.caption: LEVEL 1 pe
beats.visual: Hard cut to morning sun: the same you, calm, smirking at the camera with the phone in hand (0.9x slow-motion). 'LEVEL 4' in brand blue.
beats.sfx: whoosh into a quiet morning room tone + one soft notification ding
beats.why: Contrast = curiosity: 'what does the Level 4 guy know?' The voice says most are stuck at Level 1 while the Level 4 guy smirks. Then cut to your avatar asking 'Aap kaunse level pe ho?'

beats.words: Aap kaunse level pe ho? Dekhte hain.
beats.caption: AAP KAUNSE LEVEL?
beats.visual: Full-frame face, direct address. A glowing 'YOU?' marker is planted on the staircase as we cut back.
beats.sfx: short whoosh into the next beat
beats.why: Opens the main loop (where are you?) with the face carrying the question; breaks the split pattern early.

beats.words: Level 1: Chat. Sawaal poocha, jawab copy kiya. Bas.
beats.caption: jawab COPY kiya
beats.visual: Step 1: question bubble 'Instagram caption likh do' -> generic grey answer; a copy icon clicks.
beats.sfx: pop on the bubble, click on 'copy'
beats.why: Viewer recognises themselves; grey, flat colour = 'basic'.

beats.caption: PROJECTS
beats.visual: Camera climbs to step 2: a folder labelled 'Mera Business' opens.
beats.why: Each level = one climb, so the viewer always knows where they are.

beats.words: FAQs aur brand ki tone ek baar Project mein daal do.
beats.caption: EK BAAR daal do
beats.visual: Three cards drop into the folder, each landing on its spoken word.
beats.sfx: three paper contacts, on the words
beats.why: Concrete objects instead of a definition; 'ek baar' = low effort.

beats.words: Ab har jawab aapke business ki bhasha mein aata hai.
beats.caption: AAPKE BUSINESS ki
beats.visual: The same question from beat 4 now gets a blue answer naming the shop and its price.
beats.why: Callback to beat 4: same question, better answer = visible change of state.

beats.words: Level 3: Connectors. Gmail, Calendar aur Drive jodo.
beats.caption: Gmail · Calendar · Drive
beats.visual: Step 3: three text chips (Gmail, Calendar, Drive; no logos) plug into a 'Claude' hub, one per word.
beats.why: Text chips instead of redrawn logos (kit rule: never fake a brand mark).

beats.words: Ab Claude khud emails padh ke reply draft karta hai,
beats.caption: reply DRAFT
beats.visual: An enquiry email opens; a reply drafts itself line by line.
beats.why: Shows the action and its result, not just a label.

beats.words: aur meeting calendar mein daal deta hai.
beats.caption: CALENDAR mein
beats.visual: A calendar slot fills: 'Thu 4:00 PM · Client call'.
beats.why: Second concrete result; quick, under 2 s.

beats.words: Aur bhejne se pehle aapse poochta hai.
beats.caption: PEHLE poochta
beats.visual: An approval card; a cursor taps 'Approve' and a check mark lands.
beats.why: Trust beat; true by default (Anthropic help centre: each action needs your approval).

beats.caption: SCHEDULED TASKS
beats.visual: Camera reaches step 4: a large clock reads 9:00 AM. Small tag: 'Paid plan'.
beats.why: Top of the staircase; the 'Paid plan' tag keeps it honest.

beats.words: Ek baar bolo: har subah 9 baje kal ki saari enquiries ki summary bhejo.
beats.caption: HAR SUBAH 9 baje
beats.visual: The instruction types into a single card, then the card pins itself to the clock.
beats.why: Shows the exact instruction the viewer can copy (it's in the guide).

beats.words: Aur ye roz apne aap hota hai, laptop band ho tab bhi.
beats.caption: laptop BAND ho
beats.visual: Days flip Mon to Sun; a summary arrives at 9:00 each day while a closed laptop sits beside it.
beats.why: Repetition shows 'automatic'; the closed laptop proves the claim visually (runs remotely per the help centre).

beats.words: Yahan Claude chatbot nahi, aapka assistant ban jaata hai.
beats.caption: aapka ASSISTANT
beats.visual: Full-screen staircase with the face in a circle: the 'YOU?' marker from beat 3 climbs to step 4 and glows.
beats.why: Payoff closes the open loop from beat 3; the layout change marks the climax.

beats.words: Har level ka setup aur ready prompts maine ek free guide mein daal diye hain.
beats.caption: FREE GUIDE
beats.visual: A guide cover with 4 tabs (Chat, Projects, Connectors, Scheduled) slides in.
beats.why: Shows exactly what they get before the ask.

beats.words: (IG) Chahiye to follow karo aur comment karo LEVEL. Guide seedha aapke DM mein.
beats.caption: comment LEVEL
beats.visual: Big 'Comment LEVEL' pill + follow button; a DM icon pops. YT cut swaps this beat for: 'WhatsApp channel · link in description' (55.0-59.0 s).
beats.sfx: pop on LEVEL, gentle outro hit
beats.why: Keyword CTA (44% of niche outliers use it); separate YT ending, since YT has no comment-to-DM.
